q = [8.162651283782907e-07, 0.9926697611808777, 7.294997317330854e-08, 0.12085849046707153]

def show(tag):
    o = call(name='observe_rlbench_scene', include_raw=False)
    d = o.output
    pe = d.get('object_pose_evidence') if isinstance(d, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(pe, dict):
        print(tag, 'no pe')
        return None
    lds = pe.get('task_low_dim_state')
    gp = pe.get('gripper_pose')
    if gp:
        print(tag, 'grip', [round(v, 3) for v in gp[:3]])
    if lds and len(lds) >= 29:
        print(tag, 'lidA', [round(v, 4) for v in lds[22:29]])
    return lds

a = call(name='move_rlbench_arm_to', target_pose=[0.2353, -0.0501, 0.99] + q, strategy='pose')
print('above', a.ok)
show('above')

b = call(name='move_rlbench_arm_to', target_pose=[0.2353, -0.0501, 0.905] + q, strategy='pose')
print('lower', b.ok)
show('lower')
